assertions.name: a real gap exists to notify about
a template records its version and content digest
re-issuing a template creates a new version rather than editing one
a template code must be a stable identifier
a task cannot be raised about a record that does not exist
a new task is queued and nothing more
queueing needs no external evidence because ORVIA did it
a duplicate task for the same source and template is refused
nothing beyond queueing may be recorded without evidence
delivery cannot be claimed before anything was sent
this deployment does not claim an in-app inbox it has not built
in-app delivery cannot be claimed from a workspace list
acknowledgement cannot be claimed before delivery
the refused claims leave only the real queue fact
the delivery log cannot be rewritten
a recorded failure does not fabricate success
attempts count the recorded failure
a channel this deployment cannot deliver on is declared unavailable
the queue note says the message will not be sent
a message cannot be claimed as sent on an unavailable channel
the sweep asserts that no deadline changed
the sweep escalated the overdue undelivered tasks
the sweep states that a missed deadline stays missed
the deadline is byte-for-byte unchanged after escalation
the escalation states its reason
an in-app task that could not be delivered is escalated
a second sweep does not manufacture new escalations
the database itself refuses to move a source deadline
an auditor may read notification tasks
an auditor cannot record a delivery
a member without the notification capability is refused
